<!-- Write the title and body in English. See https://github.com/takahirox/webgpu-devtools/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md -->

## Summary

Explain the problem and the focused changes that address it.

## Outcome

Describe the resulting behavior, including before/after examples when useful.

## Validation

List checks actually performed and their results. Report failures, skipped checks, and unperformed checks with reasons. Choose checks appropriate to the changed files and existing repository tooling; documentation-only changes do not require runtime or device tests.

## Related Issues

Link the source Issue and any related Issues. Use and preserve `Closes #N` when this PR fully implements that Issue and satisfies applicable mandatory pre-merge acceptance, even if post-merge-only verification is pending. For intentional partial implementation, state the remaining scope and use a non-closing reference such as `Related to #N`.

## Required post-merge verification

List genuinely required post-merge checks separately, marked pending until performed, or state that none are required. Do not claim deployment or publication succeeded based on pre-merge validation. Follow the [post-merge lifecycle](https://github.com/takahirox/webgpu-devtools/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md#6-perform-required-post-merge-verification): merge and close the original Issue, then record evidence and track actual defects in new or equivalent linked Issues. Report environment blockers honestly; closure does not claim pending checks passed.
